what: The attempts at the baseline run (the same request, a stock agent, no plugin) on 2026-11-24. No site was built and no model output was used in any of them. A medium-sized test request (about 7,000 tokens in) also got no first byte in 150 to 240 s at 09:07, 09:33 and 09:41 UTC, while one-word requests were answered in 3 to 25 s. Attempt 4 was made after the third site run, at 13:42 UTC: by then the service refused requests outright (HTTP 503, high demand) instead of dropping them, for the build model and for the judge model alike.
